# Data Source: catalyst_stratus_bucket

Read the regional URL and versioning status of an existing Stratus bucket. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.buckets.READ` and project access. Both versioned and unversioned buckets can be inspected.

-> **Note:** This data source reads existing infrastructure. It does not create
or modify the service. Select the matching project, data center and environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "edson-edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

data "catalyst_stratus_bucket" "existing" {
  project_id  = "123456789"
  bucket_name = "example-bucket"
}

output "bucket_versioning_enabled" {
  value = data.catalyst_stratus_bucket.existing.versioning_enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) Existing lowercase Stratus bucket name.
- `project_id` (String) Existing Catalyst project's positive numeric ID as a string.

## Attribute Reference

- `url` (String) Verified regional HTTPS bucket endpoint.
- `versioning_enabled` (Boolean) Whether object versioning is enabled on the bucket.
